entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Totenda Mwari zvakare zuva remuteuro zvakare nhasi, mukana watapihwa kuti tigugudze asi ngatitendei chaizvo nekuda kwemharidzo yedu yane zuro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hachisi chinhu chiri nyore kuti uzive kuti nzvimbo yekunamatira imwe…? [Congregation says, “imwe chete.”] Unokura uchingofunga kuti dzakawanda, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti ndozvazvakaita mukati menyi…? [Congregation says, “menyika,”] menyika. But chionai nyasha dzatakawana, try and think what price you would pay just to find yourself in the right pla…? [Congregation says, “place.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Just imagine ha’moona, Mwari paanonamatiwa pamwe chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] And ipapo paanonamatiwa ipapo ndopa Spoken Word, ndopa Shoko rechinzvarwache…chenguva ino. Zvimwe zvose i Come out, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvimwe zvose i Come out. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nyangwe ukazoderera sei pakunamata kwako rega kumbofa wakafunga kuti uchanowana kumwe kunamata kune… imwe nzvimbo you only become reli…? [Congregation says, “religious,”] religious but chi Kristu panenge pa…? [Congregation says, “pasina.”] And like any better thing, any better thing it’s better than kuenda mukanda, it’s better than ku—kurova mai…? Makuva. You get by but pakanzi naMwari hunzai zvegumi zvenyu, farai nemhuri dzenyu nedzimba dzenyu pamunenge makaropafadzwa naMwari inzvimbo yandinenge ndaisa Zita rangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka nzvimbo yavakaisa Zita ravo i Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Salvation Army, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Watchtower, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Apostolic Faith, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu ZAOGA, havana kuisa Zita ravo mu Postori vakaisa Zita ravo in a Body Word. Mu Body Word imomo ndomavakaisa Zita ravo Zita ravo hupe…? [Congregation says, “hupenyu,”] Hupenyu. Imomo ukamunamata imomo, I assure you my brother. Zvandirikukutaurirai izvi kuti they will be a change of status kune vanhu vanonamata varimo…? [Congregation says, “imomo.”] Zvinoitika chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka iwewe tenda Mwari kuti wakarasikira panzvimbo irinani, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunyangwe munhu anenge arimu Church dzinenge dzinomboziva nezve Message, wakarasikira munzvimbo irinani kwakanzi ndichakutumirai mutumwa wechi no…? [Congregation says, “wechi nomwe.”] Ukarasikira imomo, vamwe varikurasikira mu Church dzinotangwa nevanhu. Ha’moona munoona nziyo yedu yatinoimba, Ma—maiona, masunungurwa nhasi. Maoina, maiona nyeredziya zvino. Ndeyekwa Mwazha, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukanzwa vachiti maiona nyeredzi yazvino varikureva ani…? [Congregation says, “Mwazha.”] Varikureva Mwazha.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Isusu takazoiti ayewa maiona here nyeredzi yazvino tichireva chii… tichireva Malachi 4…? [Congregation says, “4:5.”] William Marrion Branha…? [Congregation says, “Branham.”] Vaya vanenge vachiti chokwadi chazvino vachireva chavo chavanoparidza ikoko hatiizivi doctrine yekwa Mwazha but isu tiri kuti chokwadi chazvini tichireva Message Spoken Word yenguva i…? [Congregation says, “inoyi.”] Dzakawanda nzvimbo dzinonzi dzinonamata Mwari but Mwari ane nzvimbo imwe chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Manje ndakutaura manje iye zvino inini, ndiri kutaura ndichi bhesa patestimony, It’s like a testimony when we talk about this. Kuti ndava fifty-four years handina kumbobata mushonga kana dumwa kana zango handi murikupa nzwisisa ipapo ?[Congregation says, “Amen.”] But zvandaiitirwa na Mwari inini up to now vanhu vese vanozviona, varipano vano hedhuka nevakabva vakabamuka nevane dzimwe church nevari mu Message vanofunga kuti itokoroshi. Kuti vati isimba raMwari vanonetseka kuti vazvitaure because vanonzi kokana ririsimba raMwari murikudii kuyendawo ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Saka vanotichii… hanzi mushonga.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hapana waunosangana naye akakuudza kuti Brother Gumbura Mwari arikuva daira. Zvonzi, “Murume uya ane tokoroshi uya, murume uya ane zvikwambo uya, iwe mari yake inobva kupi anogara ane mari, iwe he, wamboona zvaari kuita, iye zvino atenga chakati, iye zvino atenga chakati.” Now imagine ini ndiri mumba mangu panguva iyoyo. Ndiri kunyatsoziva kuti handina chandabata kunze kweku gugudza chete. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndakaona vanhu vachiita divisi, rekuita one tonne yechibage [Apostle chuckles—ED] Handisi kukureverai nhema. Kumamisha kwese kwamunorima uku anenge ane divisi uchiona vanhu vachiungana pamba pake nekuti wauya nezvi kochikari ten zvebo—zve—zvechibage zvichidhonzwa nemadhongi chokutuka uku, waoona vanhu kuti ,”Heyi!” And akatozviyendera kun’anga izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Makaona murume akapuhwa tokoroshi neimwe n’anga yeku…Chipinge uku kwaMutare uku akazouraya mukadzi nevana. Handi vakataura zvaakanga anazvo? Wouldn’t you wonder kuti ndozvinouraira munhu. Ndosaka vakazuyaka panenge paine vanhu vari kunamata Mwari chaiye chaiye vanoti ah-ah ha ah- .

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: “Ini ndinokuziva kunamata ini baba vangu vakanga vari muPostori.” Wanzwa, “Isu toziva kunamata kumusha kwedu kwatakabva baba vangu vakanga vari mufundi we Metho…? [Congregation says, “Methodist,”] Methodist.” Wanzwa, “Ini kunamata takakura tinako kumba kwedu takanga tiri ma Dutch” Wanzwa isu kunamata ah taive madhirezi marefubaba vangu nanhasi izvozvi ndokwavanopinda kumba kwedu hakupirwe mudzimu asi zvakadai hatina kumbozviona.” Hongu zvakadai zvinowaikwa panzvimbo yakaiswa Zita naMwari [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen kavaranda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvinowanikwa panzvimbo yakaiswa Zita nani…? [Congregation says, “naMwari.”] Hanzi ipapo ndinosangana nani… nemi. That’s where God meet the sinner, ndosaka iwewe pakuuya panapa tenda Mwari musiwe mutsanyo unowu. Namata uchiti, “Baba ndiri panzvimbo tsvene, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] ndiri panzvimbo yamakaisa Zita rani…? [Congregation says, “renyu.”] Ndiri panzvimbo yamakati munosangana nemuta…? [Congregation says, “nemutadzi.”] Ndauya pano ndine blood issue, ndauya pano ndine barren womb, ndauya pano ndinoda basa, ndauya pano ndiri kunetswa nemweya yema…? [Congregation says, “yema dzinza.”] Makati ipapo munosangana nemutendi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndomanamatiro andakanga ndichiita hupenyu hwangu hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese.”] Until nhasi mukoma wangu akasvika chaanotanga kutaura, “Ah, hah kunamata kwakanaka veduwe, Mwari akakuitirai nyasha.” Vakasangana newe mu town vachingokuona wakwamira unoshaya kuti vaonei, wakangomira so. “Wonzwa, “ha kunamata kwakanaka veduwe Mwari vakakuitirai nyasha.” Vanhu kuti vaite barika, vaita barika irimishonga. Vamwe vakadzi vari vezvikwambo ,but iwe unoita rako ende vana ava ndevani… ndevako. Kwete vekuchekeresa vachifa gore negore kuti vafadze mweya yetsvi…? [Congregation says, “yetsvina.”] Handisi kukunyeperai vanhu vaMwari ndosaka ndichiti, this is more of a testimony. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vhangeri yandinokuparidziri handisikuvhange—kuparidza Vhangeri yekungoparidza badziba, Message iyi ndakaiona ichindigadzirira vakadzi, could you think yourself lucky kuti unota vakadzi seven pasina anokudyisa, pasina muroyi, pasina hure vese vari seven vakadaro. Zvakamboitika kupi? Vakasakunetsa kubuda mumba vachiyenda kuma storo, uchingosvika mumwe ayenda mumwe achitiza nezvinhu where you have ever seen anything like that

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ugoita vana vako twenty chakuti very healthy, active and intelligent. Pagouya chikafu chavanodya vachira…? [Congregation says, “vachirasa.”] Mota dzavanofambisa jahwi, pekugara space dzimwe dzimba dzinenge dzisina vanhu muripo twenty-four kudaro dzimwe dzimba hadzina vanhu. Where have you ever seen anything like that kunze kwekuti pakadimurwa misoro yevanhu, kunze kwekuti pakarombewa hah-ah zvino hapana kuromba kwakaitwa apa hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndiye Mwari wandiri kukuvigirai manheru echiShanu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndowandiri kuti tsvaga Mwari iye…? [Congregation says, “iyeye.”] Mukutsanya umu, ndoda kuti Mwari mundipe sadza, kunamata kumanifetswa kwehupenyu. Ndoda kuti mundipe sadza mundipe hutano, mundipe pekugara, mundipe chekufambisa, mundipe zita rakanaka, mundipe huro—huremu. Ndoda change of sta…? [Congregation says, “status.”] Don’t take what you have got for granted, fanka imimi makapinda mu Message musina kumbobata mushonga.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: It takes time for a man to realize what God is doing for him until wakura. Saka inini pandaka tanga kupinda mu Message ndichiona Mwari achindipa imba ku Lundpark, achindipa imba ku Riverside, achindipa Bluebird nyowani, achindipa imba ku Ridgemont. It never entered my head kuti that was God showing his love to me. It was after some time manje after ndaona vanhu vandakanga ndinavo kuzvikoro, vakanga vakaita intelligent kundida… kundidarika. Vakutova mazera angu aya vasina [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] chinhu, vamwe vacho [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] vane Aids, vamwe [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] vakaramba vakadzi, vamwe vane vana [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] mumatondo, vamwe varikunetswa [Apostle claps his hands once—ED] nemweya yemudzimu. Ndopandakazoti ko inini chii…?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Could this be lucky, lucky for thirty years lucky? Ah-ah ndopandakabata kuti idzi inyasha idzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari pane chavakandiratidza chinokosha chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Ndopandakati ayewa ndinotakurana nacho chinhu ichocho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiuye kuva tsvene ndivaudze kuti “Gugudza unozarurirwa, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tsvaka unodii…? [Congregation says, “unowana.”] Kumbira unoita sei…?” [Congregation says, “unopihwa.”] Mwari havana chavasingape, mari, dzimba hembe, chikafu, vana, madzimai. Zvose anodii…? [Congregation says, “anopa.”] Hapana chekutsvaga munyika. Munyika unonzwa ha ukanamata, ukanamataka unongoita mukadzi one but munyika unoita vakadzi hombo unofara ndiyani akakutaurira izvozvo, iyo iRoma yakakudza izvozvo ndi Satan. But kana wane zvinhu zvako madzimai unoita aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoda.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Murikuona kunaka kwenyasha, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudzimai mumwe nemumwe anowana imba yani…? [Congregation says, “yake.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe…?” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvinotaura chii…? [Congregation says, “Mweya.”] Mweya kupiko…?” [Congregation says, “kukereke.”] Manheru ano brother namata nekuti change of status it’s a reality because inini ndakamira pamberi pako panapa, nekuda kwekutenda Message iyoyi I saw it ha…? [Congregation says, “happening.”] I saw it happen, hapana chimwe chinhu chandakambodzidza kana chimwe chinhu—kana imwe trick iripo kungotora mwoyo wako wowuyisa muShoko rani…? [Congregation says, “paMwari.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Message ndeye mazviro kwazvo but chiendai munotarisa vamwe vakapedza makore avo vachinamata muma denomination, Salvation Army unoraramawo ehe unoitawo zvaunotendawo Mwari but there— it’s nothing to talk about, it’s nothing to go home about it’s nothing. Its general success kakungogarawo but kwete wamu Message iyi Message iyi inokusvista pekuti iwe unotenda wega iwe hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unotenda wega kuti Mwari ndinotenda hangu, [Apostle claps his hands nine times] nekuda kwezvamandidii…? [Congregation says, “zvamandiitira.”] Hatipindei pakunyengetera tine nzwisiso iyoyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Manheru anha…? [Congregation says, “anhasi.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndirikutsuura mweya yema dzinza, ndiri kutsuura hurombo, ndiri kustuura hurovha, ndoda kuiswa panzvimbo yangu chai…? [Congregation says, “chaiyo.”] SeMwenga baba toda kuva nehuremu hunoenderana nokutenda kwati…? [Congregation says, “kwatinako,”] kwatinako. Mwari pindirai, mupinde mu project yangu ive ropafadzo whether ndeyemadomasi whether ndeye huku dzenyama kana dzema zai, whether ndeye kurima. Manje ini ndinozviziva kuti Mwari haambo kanganisi…Handindakakuudzai kuti inini muchandiona pandinenge nda—ndanyatsogudzikana zvangu ndino vhura factory inonzi Mupedza Nha…? [Congregation says, “Mupedza nhamo.”] Inenge ichipeka nyama, mo—ye dze—dze huku idzi, mazai, cooking oiri ndichirima ndoga sun furawa, nzungu ndichirima ndoga ndichiita dovi inenge ichinzi Mupedza nhamo inenge yakagadzirirwa factory yayo. Now vazhinji venyu hamuna kuziva kuti ndatodairwa kudhara.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndakazvitaura, Hillsi—Hi—Hilltop tisati tana…? [Congregation says, “tanawo.”] Manje handimoona pekuvaka factory yacho tatovana…? [Congregation says, “napo.”] Pekuita huku dzacho tatovana…? [Congregation says, “napo.”] Takutogadzira izvozvi zvozvi, handi ndakakutaurirai kuti haikona kuzoshamisika kana zvadii…? Mavakirwo achaitwa pa Hilltop paya kana iwe ucharohwa nehana, ndirikuisa factory yedovi, factory ye cooking oil ipopaya, packing yemazai, dzi—dzihuku dzenyama slaughter house everything zvatakataura zvese. Ndendichi supl-ya muma town zvichibva pa farm yangu.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ende pandakazvitaura Hillsi—Hilltop ndangandisati ndaio…? Yangaisati yavapo, I never knew kuti ndine ndinayo. Kwaingova kuparidza nokutenda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvino iye zvino the only reason why we have delayed, we were clearing a space panapa yekuti ti kriyete [to create—ED] dzimba dzekurara toisa convention centre yedu, whether convention centre inoita or haite pano ikasaita pano ndinenge ndine five acres land muno mu Harare dzatinoisa Convention Centre iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Kunze kwaizvozvo tinoita pano. Tichibva pano tinotenda papurazi paya tirikuno ruka mari zveruka mari zviya Mwari vakati, “Sirivhera nendarama ndezvani…?” [Congregation says, “ndezvangu.”] [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vanotaura kuti tokoroshi vachanyarara kuti zi! Ndosaka muchiona isu hatinetseki nevanotisiya, when you see me next year, I will be better. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tatichitaura naamai vatakatenga tinavo pano gogo vaya, Gogo Francis vaichengeta—vaigara mu cottage umu patakauya tichitenga panapa. Vakauya last time ndikavati ratidzwai naMai Zani, “ah ndachifunga kuti,” vavachitenga muriwo nema seedlings.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Ndandichifunga kuti iyo imba iriuko iyi yatova imwe stand maka sub divi-dha mukatengesa.” Ndikati, “Ayehwa ndepanapa.” Zvikanzi, “Zvamaita panapa nenguva dukuduku.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Saka nhasi vauya futi, saka nhasi vapinda mu lounge yangu iyo yandakaisa pine nemudenga umu vakapinda zvikanzi, “Ah” vakubuda naMai Zani. Zvikanzi, “Nhai imi Pastor muri Pastor here kana kuti muri architecture?” [Congregation laughs—ED] Muri kuona muhedheni uyu handiti. Hanzi mu…Ndikati, “Hindava?” Zvikanzi, “Makaita.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndikati, “Ah, ndikati hoo right imi munopaziva riri varanda, ehe paive varanda I put three ho—three rooms pavaranda apa.” Zvikanzi, “Pastor zvamuri kuita panapa.” Ndikati, “Ah vangadai vakakuratidzai.” Zvikanzi, “Do you know what I want to do pamba panapa.” Ndikati… Zvikanzi, zvikanzi “Ndoda kuuya every two three months ndichi…, ndoziva every ti—every two three months pandinouya panouya. I will be supri…?” [Congregation says, “surprised,”] surprised. [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hamoona munhu wemunyika uyu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]Ndiye woga arikuona izvozvo? Ah, saka ndiri kukutaurirai kuti kana munhu mukanamata Message, Message yechizvarwa chenguva inoyi. Message inodarika mishonga, Message inodarika midzimu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But isa mwoyo wako pai…? [Congregation says, “pairi.”] We should die what…? [Congregation says, “daily.”] Ehe, nyatsotendeuka chaizvo chaizvo Message inokupa mota dzese dzaunoda panyika pano. Message inokupa dzimba dzaunoda dze…? [Congregation says, “dzese.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hamuna kumbosanga ne verse kuma Pisarema rinoti, “The Lord will give your hearts what…?” [Congregation says, “desire.”] Your wildest imagination God can make it rea…? [Congregation says, “reality,Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unless if you have no sense of imagination and that’s why I have always challenged you to say when you ask God think bi…? [Congregation says, “big.”] Ukauya gore rinouya pano you will be shocked regardless yekuti ta…Handi muna 2000 vakataura muchavaka here kuKwekwe nuchadii…? Vakazoti kudii Kwekwe yavakwa, makavanzwa vachitaura futi? Kunyarara kuti zii. [Apostle claps his hands twice—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vakabva vana Brother Musharu nana Mai Madovi, nana Brother Mudekwa pavakauya parufu rwaamai vangu kunyarara kuti zii. “Ah ndo cream yatinonzwa neva…nembiri iyi, cream raunji ii yakanaka Pastor.” Mai Matapura vatakasiyana navo kudhara. Zvikanzi, “Pastor mune nzvimbo yenyu yakanaka. Pastor inga Mwari haana kumbokusiyayi kubva paya.” [Congregation chuckles—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hanzi, “Mwari haana kumbokudii…? [Congregation says, “ kukusiyai.”] Kubva papi…? [Congregation says, “paya.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Hasha dzaMwari dziri pamusoro pevese vanobata zvokwadi yake mukudii…?” [Congregation says, “mukusarurama.”] Hameno zvavo vanenge vachiuya ku Church vachindinzwa ndichiparidza kudai ivo vachataura mm ha hmm ha hmm, you will always have something to a man who is sent of God chokuti unogona ku critici-za, it could be a weakness ha’moona. Jeso chaiye Kristu achiuya, vanhu vamuti nekuti anonwa wine hanzi, “Haihwaho ngaati nyararire he is wine briber,” hanzi he was a wine bri…? [Congregation says, “briber.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ehe, vaimusvora but chinoshamisa ndechekuti guva raakavigwa akarisiya risina chi…? [Congregation says, “chinhu.”] Ndo the same nhasi mu church munomu hazvirevi kuti tinenge tichitenda tose. Vamwe vanenge vachitngoti, “Hmm zvipi ko zvatinoona, haihawo zvipi zvacho.” Anenge achikutiyi zvipi zvacho but iye pese paakazvarwa haana kumbozviona. Mweya, we smearing, they smear in their hearts ha’moona? But iwe rega kuteerera vakadaro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti, Mwari ndinoda nya…? [Congregation says, “nyasha.”] One day ini ndanguri ndafa murivadiki kaimi, uchatenda kuti Pastor vakatinongedzera kune… [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Urikunzi naMwari munonamatiwa mukore uno mu Message yechizvarwa che…? [Congregation says, “chenguva.”] Ndomurikunamatiwa mukore uno, mukore unowu hakuna kumwe kuri kunamatiwa mukore unowu kunze kwemu Message. Whatever happens in the Message does not change the fact. Ndomuri kunamatiwa pachizvarwa chi…? [Congregation says, “chino.”] Hakuna ngozi, huroyi, mushonga, mudzimu usinga kurirwe kana hurombo usinga kurirwe mu Message yenguva inoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chinongodiwa have faith in God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatisimukei tese… Vakauya (Baba) vamwe vachibvunza (Isu) Tingapone here Hongu tinoda (Tinoda) muponisiwe (Baba) Nesu tinodaro (Ini ndoda) Ndoda (Ndoda) ndoda Mwari muyamuri Muri wangu Ndakatengwa (Baba) neRopa raIshe (Ropa raIshe) Ndava wenyu chose

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Breakthrough! My brother, this evening. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari i reality kwatiri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pano vanoda kuti tive pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanokuregerera zvivi zvako zvose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanodaira muteuro wako. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatipindei pakunyengetera tose. [Pentecostal prayer—ED] …in the oil and the wine. (Apostle says, “Tese one more time.”) (Hallelujah) He poured in the oil and the wine (Hallelujah) The time He restoreth my soul (My Lord) I was sick and dying on the Jericho road When He poured in the oil and the wine.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwari vaAbrahama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari vebarika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] God of polygamy. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudimu wasithembo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinotenda nezvamuri kutiitira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda nekuva pano manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tariro yatinayo yekuenda kunoparidzirana, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] muGweru, kutenda kwatinako negoho ratakawana gore rino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kufara kwatinako nehutano hwatinahwo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari hondo dzamabva kurwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba ma prospects amuri kuvhura mberi kwedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari muri Mwari vakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] You are a good God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Worthy of worship. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Here Lord, we all believe and understand, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndopamunosangana nevahedheni. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mu Gentile wese muShoko remutumwa wechinomwe, munomuwanira nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopatiri manheru ano, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Chitsuurai mweya yemadzinza, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nokuti Shoko iri rine simba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tsuurai hurombo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tsuurai barrenness. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya we discord in the Name of Jesus! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitibatsirai Mwari wakanaka pakufamba kwedu mune ramangwana zuva, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba kugadzirira kwedu kwa August. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Vatsvene vari kufamba mangwana kubva Botswana, kubva Joni, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vaitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba vari Britain. Baba makanaka vari kuronga, Amereka, kuti tive navo muna August, vaitirei nyasha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tinotenda nevana vedu, totenda nemadzimai edu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari wakanaka nepamunotitsvakira pekugara. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari zvokufambisa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotsuura mweya wendufu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totsuura mweya wehurwere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Batsirai vose Baba wakarurama vasiri kunzwa zvakanaka, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vakazvitakura, Baba vanonoka kubatsirwa, vana vari underweight, vasina mbereko vari kudzichemera, Baba makanaka pindirai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari makanaka chipindai mukati memba ino Jehovah. Baba makanaka mharidzo yedu ive mharidzo yenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigare hedu tese pasi.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda Mwari chaizvo kuti tava muimba yaMwari zvakare musi weChishanu. Every time we come, we are–we complete a fast like this, kana tanga taswera zvechokwadi tiri committed, you have your request answered. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Let every man be a…? [Congregation says, ‘a liar,’] and God’s Word be…? [Congregation says, ‘true,’] true.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvaaku depender nekuti waswera uri mu condition yakadii. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vamwe havawoni chekunamatira nekuti cho–cho–chomweya chagara ha–ha–ha–hachisati chajeka kwavari. But kunesu takaziva hedu kuti Mwari anodaira miteuro, Mwari anopa, Mwari anokunda mweya yemadzinza, zuva rakadai tino… Izvozvi tichitoburuka so, taakutoita look forward to next Wednesday. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Inenge ichitori kure kwandiri nekuti takazvipira kuti gore rese tinopinda pakute…? [Congregation says, “pakuteura.”] Tatova halfway through the year.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tichipinda muna July, handitika, tatova mu seven months. Handi’moona kuti gore riri–hachisi chinhu chihombe? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But toda kuti rapera gore iroro utarise kumasure kwako, wana mhinduro muzvinhu zvaunoda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi ndoda kuti ndingoenda mberi ne message yedu yanezuro yeNzvimbo Tsvene, handi’moona. But ndoda kupa emphasis pavana, paNzvimbo Tsvene iyi. Tichibuda nezuro, Pastor vakabva vandivinga vachinditi, “Ah, message yamamuchiparidza,” Pastor Chuma, zvikanzi, “Ko zvayanga iripo kana kumba kwangu uku.” Ndikati, “Hindava?” Zvikanzi, “Ah, Tsitsi akauya akandikumbira kuti baba ndoda kuenda ku S.U.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Do you know kuti they don’t see why anything wrong with that? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ehe. Vada kuenda ku S.U. Saka iwe unoshaya kuti unomurambidza sei kuti usaende here kana kuti enda. Hau–you do–you don’t know what to do. But as a parent you know kuti hakuna chaanonodii…? [Congregation says, “chaanonodzidza,”] chaanonodzidza ikoko. But kwaari kunamata kwese. So, what we need to do as a church, ma parents ese, is to over drill your children, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] in what is proper. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinganzwa Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Saka while tine burden yedu iyi, yekudanwa kwatakaita naMwari, ende tichitaura kuti nzvimbo inonamatiwa imwe chete kunyangwe dzikawanda mu Message handitika, nzvimbo idzi? But nhamo yatinayo huru ndeyekudzidzisa vana vedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vedu kuti vazive kuti zvatakapinda mazviri izvi iShoko rani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari,”] raMwari. Vana ka, havazi vanhu vekungorasharasha. Right. Hatingoverengayi MaGwaro mambichana anotaridza nezvekukosha kwevana.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vanofanira kuziva nezveNzvimbo Tsvene. Handei kuna Jobhi chapter 30. Rotanga nekuti–tiratidza, kuregerera vana zvakunoita. Job 30. I just want a–a Scripture there. Right. Hatitarisei muone pa verse ya 5 muone. Ndoda kuti mungotora pfungwa yenyu mega zvinoitika. Hativerengeyi kubva pa verse 5 tese: They were driven forth from among men,

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen munhu wese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;) Handei mberi: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Handei muone: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together. Why? Handei muone pa verse 8: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muri kuona kuti kudhara kwanga kusina ma streets, kwaive nemakomo. Vana vemapenzi ndovaiwanikwa vari kumakomo iko…? [Congregation says, “ikoko.”] Vaiwana vanhu vachivatandanisa vachivamhanyira vachivati, “Mbavha! Mbavha!” Vana vemapenzi nhasi ndovanowanikwa muma streets futi nanha…? [Congregation says, “nanhasi.”] Ehe. Ma street kids. Kana baba vakasava munhu kwaye, mwana wako rinoita rombe che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Muri kupabata ipapo? Ehe.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ukaona vana vakazara muma street vaya vaya, mwana webenzi nekuti dai baba vake vakanga vari munhu kwaye vangadei vakamuudza kuti izvi hazviitwe izvi. Ende vangadei vakagadzirira vana vavo pekuga…? [Congregation says, “pekugara.”] Tinganzwa Amen here ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Gadzirira mwana wako pokugara. It has never been the desire of God that vana vazvigadzirire. Mwari akada kuti baba vashingairire vana vawane pekudii…? [Congregation says, “pekugara,”] pekugara, handi’moona.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Saka already ndatoona chinhu one. Ndopane dzidziso yangu apa. Baba vakava rombe, mwana akakura, anovashora. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa ngaapfuure ipapo Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba vakava rombe, mwana akakura akatanga kuita zvinhu zvine musoro anosvora ba…? [Congregation says, “baba,”] baba. Saka baba ngavave something chekuti vana kana vakura vanotarisa kuna baba kuti baba ngavatipewo ichi, ngavatibatsire apa, ngavatibatsire apa. Vane chavanoona chakaitwa naba…? [Congregation says, “nababa.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka nyaya yedu ye change of status, we can never over emphasize it hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana uri murume ane zvinhu zvake hapana mwana anoku challenger kuti baba muri kuita zvinhu zvisiri izvo. Ndosaka vana vevanhu vane vanhu–vane zvinhu zvavo, vana baba vavo kana vakazviwana nematokoroshi, kana vakazviwana nezvikwambo, vana ava tokoroshi idzi vachadzodzitambira che…? [Congregation says, “chete,”] chete nekuda kwezvinhu zvepanya…?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvodanira nyasha dzakawandisa chaizvo chaizvo kuti mwana ana baba vanoita tokoroshi afuratire benz yababa so yetokoroshi, afure double s–afuratire double storey yeku Borrowdale yakatengwa netokoro…? [Congregation says, “netokoroshi.”] Afuratire purazi rababa retokoroshi, hazvigoneke izvo. Mupfanha uya anongopedzesera aita give in kuzvinhu i…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Arikuda kurarama, ari kuti baba vangu tokoroshi yavo ndopayakavasvitsa apa. Ndoyakatiendesa kuchikoro tokoroshi iyi. Nhasi ndozoti zvinhu zvababa vangu…Ukanzwa vanhu vachiti musha umwe neumwe une zvinhu zvawo, ndozvinenge zvichireva vanhu izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndopandiri kuti vanhu vaMwari imimi mune duty iye zvino muri vapfanha so kuti wana zvinhu zvako neShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vana vako vanenge vaakuti ukamira uchitaura kuti ndakawana pfuma iyi naMwari, hapana anouya nemushonga kana kukuudza kuti handei tinopira mudzimu kana tirove guva ranhingi. Hapana anouya achitaura kuti handei tinoshopera. But mupfanha unenge akakurira mumakomo saizvozvi izvi, akasangana netokoroshi anoramba?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndooka vapfanha ka ava, vana vemapenzi, vana ve base men. Anosvika pane benz yakasiiwa neumwe ine tokoroshi yakagaramo makuseni, heh. Anosvika achivhura benz iyoyo achifamba nayo. Kwaakutoitora kuenda nayo pamba pake. Ko ana baba? Ende nhamo ndoyamutungamirira kuti anotora benz iyoyo. Vamwe vese vachiyiwona benz vachiyitiza, ine katokoroshi kanogara kumasure. Handi makainzwa nyaya yakaitika kuKadoma yetokoroshi yaka… yakasiiwa ine benz?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hanzi tokoroshi yakasiiwa ine benz kudai. Muchinda wacho akati ah-ah, benz yanga yamu… tokoroshi yanga yamuuraira hama dzake dzese, akairamba akasiya zvikanzi, “Anoda benz iyi nezviri mairi ngaatore.” Tokoroshi iyi yaigara mu benz imomo ichimuka kuseni ichisumuka achiti “Shaina kana zuva richisa–richibuda.” [Congregation laughs—ED] … [Inaudible 30:39] Nziyo iya inonzi, [Apostle sings briefly—ED] “Shaina kana zuva richibuda …” [Apostle and Congregation laugh—ED] Yaimuka ichiita–ichiti shainawo… [Inaudible 30:46]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vanhu vakawanda vakairamba kuitora benz iyoyo vakaisiya yakadaro but, munofunga kuti yakaramba yakadaro kwenguva? Pakaita m–mwana webenzi, mwana we a base fe…? [Congregation says, “fellow,”] akanga anzwa nenha…? [Congregation says, “nenhamo.”] Benz iyoyo akaidii…? [Congregation says, “akaitora.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka munhu anodimbura munhu musoro kuenda kunopuhwa kombi uchiti munhu wawadimbura musoro mweya wake uchaita sei? Achateera kombi iyoyo yaatengwa nemusoro wake. Ropa ratotanga mu yard iyo…? [Apostle claps four times—ED] [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka isu tinoti kwamuri mose, set footprints on the sands of time. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuti vana Munesu kana vakura, vana John Junior, vana Ngoni, vana Jayden, vanongoziva Mwari wavari kuratidzwa nana baba vaani…? [Congregation says, “vavo.”] Baba vanenge vachiti, “Mupfanha ndakatenga apa, ndikatenga apa. Mupfanha ndakaita farming yangu apa, mupfanha. Apa ndakaita…Mwari wandinonamata uyu ndiMwari wemuna…?” [Congregation says, “wemunana.”] Zvekuti akanzwa vamwe vachitaura tokoroshi anoseka, kuti, “Hoo, zvenyu ndezvetokoroshi? Aah isu kwatinobva…”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Wonzi, “Ko imimi munozviwana…?” “Haa isusu tiri vekunamata.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvonzi, “Haa ibva manhi iwe. Kunamata kwakambobatsira munhu here?” Zvonzi, “Ehe.” Zvonzi, “But baba vangu vainamata ka ini vari mu Methodist preacher. But takanga tiri varombo vasingaite.” Zvonzi, “Ah-ah, hamuna kuziva nzvimbo tsvene.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pane nzvimbo tsvene yekuti ukaiziva iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo,”] Mwari vanokupa ma desires ako o…? [Congregation says, “ose.”] Handei munoona ruGwaro. Handei tinoona pa Proverbs. Ndoda Proverbs 17. Tiri kuona kukosha kwevana chete. Tasvika pa Proverbs 17? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tarirai muone verse ya 6 tione. Ndoda munhu wese ati Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatiitei Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi verse a— [Blank spot on tape—ED] …verse 6 tese, hativerengeyi tese: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Handisi kunzwa Amen ka varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Children’s children mufaro wasekuru. [Congregation says, Amen.’] Asi vana kubwinya kwababa vavo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’moona kudada kwaunoita kana mwana wako achigona kuita zvinhu? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi mwana anogona kuita zvinhu zvake, baba vasumudzirwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwana wese anobata zvinhu nemayi…? [Congregation says, “nemazvo,”] kubwinya kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwababa,”] kwababa. But muzukuru kubwinya kwemudhara. Baba vababa… Baba vangu zvavakaita, baba vangu vakaona vazukuru, it’s his glory, it’s his crown. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But inini ndichafara ndichiona vana Tito, vana Munesu, vachi runner zvinhu zvako zvawakavatangira iwewe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hachibi, hachitsotsi, hachipindi mumajere, hachikanganisa, hachifi neAIDS.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Imagine kutsamwa kwaunoita kuti iwe wakasvika fifty four ye–fifty four years usina mukondombera, mwana wako oita twenty one eh…years, ouya achinzi ari positive. Kana ma H.I.Vi, aya anonzi ma H.I.V.R haa… [Congregation laughs—ED] Anonzi mayi? [Congregation says, “A.R.V.”] Anonzi mayi? [Congregation says, “A.R.V.”] Ma A.R.V’s acho... [Congregation laughs—ED] haa, hawuatenge nemufa…? [Congregation says, “nemufaro.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: “Twenty -one years waakutaura kuti you are positive. What’s wrong with you young man, heh? Twenty -one years, you tell me positive! I lived in a similar world, and I got to fifty four years by the grace of what…? [Congregation says, ‘God,’] God. You tell me at twenty -one years… Haa, futseke.” [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mai vacho ndovanosara vachichema because chinoku disappoint-a. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hachingabati AIDS ne twenty years. Chaa chichimhanyira kupi? Unochibvunza kuti, “Wanga uchimhanyirepi nhai iwe mupfanha, heh? Ini baba vako ndakafa ndine vakadzi vandinoda. Handina kumbozviziva izvi. You were going to have as many women as you wanted. The one who gave you AIDS you could have just ignored her, knowing pamberi apa vakawanda uchavadii…? [Congregation says, ‘uchavawana.’] Why did you get involved with that prostitute who gave you AIDS?”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Because there is no excuse for a young man who gets positive ari size yaOsi uyu. It just means he’s stupid. Heh. Anenge akaita sei mukadzi wacho? Is there a woman ari H.I.V positive ari worth dying for? Saka iwe chii chakaita kuti ufire munhu iyeye? Why did you do it? Now, handi’moona ukange waakuvhunzwa chaizvo waa… soberness yadzoka? Kunzi, “Brother, kana mukadzi uyu anga akanaka sezvamuno claimer, ari worth it, achikosha stereki, why was the virus in her?”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: It means an unworthy person was in her at o…? [Congregation says, “at one time.”] And i–if an unworthy person was in her at one time, she wasn’t worthy you. Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona. Haumufariri mupfanha iyeye. Hamuna kunzwa kuti President Nkomo vakatuka mwana wavo afa neAIDS parufu? [Congregation says, “mm-hmm.”] Hm. Nkomo akasumuka zvikanzi, “This young man, I’ve been busy gathering wealth and money for him in Britain and in America. There are accounts with this boy. And he dies out of AIDS. Haa…” Hameno chiNdevere chaakataura… [Apostle says something imitating the Ndebele tongue and Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Zvakamukanganisa…[Inaudible 36 :42] Tiri kuunganidza pfuma handiti. Saizvozvi izvi ndiri kuunganidzira vana Tito, ivo vari kuenda kuchikoro. Ndoda kuti vaite ma… ma Accountant, vaite ma Lawyer, handitika? By the time when they are ready to take up ini ndaa seventy years, you hear mu–Munesu, positive; Tito, positive. Brother kana uri kadhara unorova vanhu nezvibhakera manheru iwayo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Panzvimbo yekuchema mesa–Ini handicheme mwana anouya achitaura kuti ndine AIDS, nekuti haiuye ichipuhwa munhu kudai AIDS. [Congregation laughs—ED] Dai yaiuya ichipuhwa munhu kudai waichema. But munhu anofamba kuenda kunoitora oga nemakumbo ake [Inaudible 37 :11] heh. Odzoka ainayo? [Apostle laughs—ED] Haha. I–I–I won’t cry ini. Ndosaka nanhasi wese munhu ari H.I.V positive, I only am sorry because of what state you are now in. Kurwara kwaunoita ndichikunzwira tsitsi. But kuti… kuti ndokunzwira tsitsi kuti unayo sei ka, handikunzwire tsitsi. You… wakaitorerei? [Congregation laugh—ED] Waiitei pawakaidii…? [Congregation says, “pawakaitora.”] Handi musikanzwa iyo?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu ari pano, raira mwana wako hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndokuti vana vaya kana vakura manje ka, havasare vachifa kana vachiita zvinhu zvisina basa. Vanosara vachiwana ropafadzo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyei Proverbs 20 muone. Hativerengeyi Proverbs 20 muone zvainotaura. Right.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Right, Proverbs 20. Right, handina kunyora hangu verse racho. Handizivi ndarikanganwa sei, but anyway hativerengei verse 11. Right, hativerengei tione verse 11 tese. Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right. Hatidzokorerei. Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right. Muri kuzviona? Hatidzokorerei futi. Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muri kuzviona? Hanzi, “Mwana anozivikanwa nemabasa aani…?” [Congregation says, “ake.”] Kana ka’akapfanha kakanaka, ha’moona, unongokaona kachiita zvakanaka. Ndosaka baba manje, vanozotora manje authority. Unogona kutora mukomana mukuru, womuti, “Iwewe handikupe zvinhu.” Woenda kukakomana kekupedzesera, woti, “Ndiwe wandinopa zvinhu.” Unenge wagutsikana nemabatiro aanoita zvinhu zvaani…? [Congregation says, “zvake.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ukati ukatuma mupfanha nezvinhu; achiba mari, anouya akashotesa zvinhu, anopwanya zvinhu, anoroveresa mota. Already unenge watoona kuti mwana uyu haasi kwazvo. Uchikura unenge waona kuti, “Ah, ava mana—mwana uyu mune da…?” [Congregation says, “dambudziko.”] Mapurisa anogara ari pa door rako nekuda kwake. [0:39:24-inaudible] like that. Ha’moona. [0:39:26-inaudible] like that.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwana akanaka anoonekwa nemabasa ake. [Congregation says, “mm.”] Ende zvinonzi neBhaibheri, “After baba vavo vafa, these kids continue being blessed.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatitarisei verse 7, ndorandandichida iro. Hatitangei pa verse 5 tese. Hativerengei verse 5. Tese verse 5 tese. Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out. Handei v—verse 6 tose. Most men will proclaim everyone his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muri kuzviona? How do we know now faithful men? Right, hatichionai verse 7. Ndoda kuti munhu [blank spot—ED] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 7 tese. The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amen varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aihwa ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, mwana… vanhu vanoti tiri vanhu vari right vakawanda chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Munhu wese anenge achingoclaima [claiming—ED] righteousness yake, but who can find a righteous man? Zvikanzi, but a man of integrity, the only way you will know a man of integrity, anopihwa confirmation ye integrity yake, nezvinosara zvoita vana vake iye adii…? [Congregation says, “aenda.”; Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka vanhu vaMwarika, it’s a great defeat for a man of my calibre, kuti ndafa, vana vangu vese voita mamwe ma Methodist, vamwe ma Baptist, vamwe ma Angrican. [Anglican—ED] Heh? Kana ndafa vana vangu vanofanira kusimudzirwa mu Message yakavaita kuti vave pano! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Brother kuti ndisangane na Zinhle, achitaura kuti, “Ini handitende Message.” I’ve never seen an insult like that, because if there wasn’t a Book rakaparidzwa na Brother Branham re Marriage and Divorce, there wouldn’t be a Zinhle. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Heh? Kuti ndisangane inini naBati, achitaura kuti izvo, “Baba inini handitende Message.” Unomuudza kuti, “Shamwari what are you talking about? That Spoken Word created you. Hah? You wouldn’t be in existence if that Spoken Word was not he…? [Congregation says, “here,”] here.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ha’moona. Kuti ndisangane kana nevana vemukadzi wangu wokutanga, vachindiudza kuti, “Hee inini handidi zvakati, handidi zvakati.” Kana kuti, Esther oti, “Ini handidi Shoko raMwari, handidi barika.” Ndomutaurira kuti, “Esther, you wouldn’t be enjoying the life you are enjoying now, if God had not made me a believer in the Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ungade usina kuenda kuzvikoro zvawakadii…? [Congregation says, “zvawakaenda.”] Ungade usingapfeke hembe dzaunodii…? [Congregation says, “dzaunopfeka.”] Ungade usingagare muimba yaunodii…? [Congregation says, “yaunogara.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: You wouldn’t been—you would be nothing, if the Spoken Word had not come my way! You are what you are, you are Esther today, a beautiful girl. You sing in a Church today, uchikompoza [composing—ED] nziyo dzako, just because God gave us grace by believing the Message!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kunze kwaizvozvo izvozvi so, horiday [holiday—ED] iri kuuya iyi, weekend tingade tichienda kuKenzamba, kunotamba ngoma husiku hwe…? [Congregation says, “hwese,”] hwese. Tingade tichidaidza masvikiro, tiri muna’nga.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Nhasi une motokari isina kudirwa doro. Why?! Nhasi unemba isina kurohwa hoko yemushonga. Why?! Nhasi une vana vasina kurapirwa nhova. Why? Nhasi iwewe une hutano, hauzive piritsi, kana jekiseni, kana chipatara. Why?! Dzidzisa vana! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ha’moona? Ndosaka madzimai kana ari mudzimba umo ngaadzidzise vana. I blame father and mother, for children vasinga-appresiete [who do not appreciate—ED] Message, because they don’t appreciate the Message because the father and mother doesn’t! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kana baba naamai vakaappresieta [they appreciate—ED] Message, mwana anotya kutaura shoko rokutaura kuti, “Message haazi Mwari.” Kana muchiappresieta [appreciate—ED] mo…? [Congregation says, “mose.”] Anoziva ziso raanopuhwa nababa vake kana namai vake kana akangotaura mashoko iwayo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Can Esther go to Mother? Ovati, “Nhai Mother, Message yacho ini handimboinzwisisa chinombori chiiko ini?” Anonzi, “Message, I want to explain to you what the Message is. It’s the air you breath.” Ha’moona, eh? Kuti, “Mwanangu uri kundiona ini, kakawanda…” Ha’moona. Zini uyu anonzi namai vake, “Zini, shut up! Wakaitira poo iwe munhumbu iwe, Chechi ikanama… [Congregation says, “ikanamata.”] I would have died and we would have died in the pro…? Hakuna n’anga yatakaenda kwai…? That’s why you are here? Heh? Ndaka’andatadza kuku deliver iwe, but dai takanga tisiri mu Message imomu, ungade usi…? [Congregation says, “usipo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mune duty vanhu vaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka brother manje vanenge vakamira saizvozvizvi, vanokwanisa kuisa curse pamwana wavo. Nokuti vakamurera nesimba reShoko Iro…? [Congregation says, “Iroro.”] But kuti uitwe curse nezvinhu zvababa vako kana vachirova makuva, vachipira mudzimu; hazvishande. Nekuti zviri inferior kune zvatakatambira iye zvi…? [Congregation says, “iye zvino.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwana wako akakumirira munzira unotaura kuti “Mwanangu, ndiri kukutaurira ndakamira panapa, Mwari wandinonamata ari kumusoro kudenga, haakutendere kuita chinhu, kusvika wadzoka muShoko iroriri, randakakukudzai na…? [Congregation says, “naro.”] Nhova yako iwe haina kurapiwa iwe. Inyasha dzaMwari dziri pauri apa. Hauna nyora kumusana, mumapendekete, mumakumbo kana muchiuno. Hauna kutsengerwa mushonga kana mbijana. Hauna ruredzo ruri pauri iwewe kana bhatani rezvifumuro. Kubva uchizvarwa mwanangu, God has looked over you.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] No! Ndozvandinoona manje kuti ma brothers mazhinji manje, they can’t do that because ivo pachavo unozoona vachihedhuka futi kubuda mu Message ya…? [Congregation says, “yacho.”; Apostle claps once—ED] How can a father who has got questions about the church he goes to, ever teach his child, anything confident iye aine pfungwa ngaani…? [Congregation says, “mbiri.”] You see your problem, where it comes from?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: How does a brother, ari kuuya kuChechi achidhauta [doubting—ED] zvaari mayi…? [Congregation says, “mazviri,”] ever sit with his or her daughter, achimunongedzera kuti Shoko raMwari rinokosha? How can he, when he himself is double-mi…? [Congregation says, “minded.”] Hanzi, “A double-minded man can never, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Amen, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] never receive anything from the…?” [Congregation says, “from the Lord.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Manje you reap what you…? [Congregation says, “sow.”] Vana vaya vachatanga kukupandukira manje. Unoita mwana wekutika, vanhu vanoramba kuti akakudzwa nababa ve Message, achiyituka.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Anotaura kuti, “Picture ya Brother Branham akakuudzai kuti i Pillar of Fire iri pamusoro payo ndiani? Inenge iri diagram ka iya. [Congregation laughs—ED] Zvema con man ekuAmereka zvamoda kuti taurira panapa. Kana iye akanga ari muporofita, hindava asina kuziva kuti nhasi ndinobhewuka? Died in a car accident. Don’t frighten me, mudhara. After all ndiri kutenda inini, nyeredzi yandinoona kwete yakafa kudhara muna 1965, ndoenda kwaMwazha.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tora kubasa Bhaibheri rake nemukadzi wake, vachienda kwaMwazha. Ende hapana chinoitika kwavari. Ha’moona. Uchaona, iwe, ah vachitoita, zvinhu kudarika zvako. Saka uchaita sayi iwewe? You are going to be forced to compromise nekuda kwe pover…? [Congregation says, “poverty.”] “Mwanangu magetsi.” Zvonzi, “Aihwazve, makatenda varungu, kwakauya Mwazha. Itai Ameni ndiuye ndobhadhara magetsi.” [Congregation laughs—ED] Toda munhu anotaura kuti, “Gara nemari yako yemagetsi, Mwari vachaita nyasha!”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ini ndakaramba ini, ndakaramba kurova makuva. Ndakaramba kana kuita chinhu hwani chandainzi nababa vangu ita chekuKenzamba uko. God did not allow me to be ashamed. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mukuona nyasha dzaMwari, ndakaramba. Vanin’ina vangu vakaita mari dzechi dealer, vakandishoropodza vachifamba nema Lexus ekuba, vachigara mudzimba dzechi dealer, ma office echi dealer, furniture yechi dealer; ndakaramba.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Did I know that God would give me the…?... more than what I want? Mwari akandipruvhira [proved to me—ED] beyond a shadow of doubt kuti no, you don’t have to be a corrupt criminal to have things. You don’t have to be wicked, kuromba kuti uve nezvinhu. Have faith in God! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen handisikumunzwa iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka vana vemunhu anonamata vakafanana nevana vakaropafadzwa muJerusarema. Baba vavo vanga vari mutendi, zvavanoda zvese vanozviwa…? [Congregation says, “vanozviwana.”] Kunze kwaizvozvo imba yechihedheni iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hativerengei tone pano. Handei pana verse ya… VaKori… Handei horaiti, handei pana… Vana vanorebela [who rebel—Ed] tingoona rebellion. Handei pana Isaiah. Isaiah chapter 1. Mirai muone manje zvinotaura Jehovha. Huyai muone verse 2 tese. Tingaita Amen tese ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 2 tose. Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen apa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndozvakafanana nemwana anoti akudzwa nababa, vachiziva Jehovha wo—wo—weMwenga, iwe woti wa’akuda umwe Jehovha. Wakutouya kuzoona kuna baba… [0:39:24-inaudible] “Hah, baba.” Ivo vakakuendesa kuchikoro nemari ye Message. Panomukirwa baba chete ndepekuti wabuda munyika, wauya mukuna…? [Congregation says, “mukunamata.”] Ndopanomukirwa baba woti, “Baba, ndiri kutoda kunamata.” Kubuda mu denomination uchienda kune zviri na…? [Congregation says, “zviri nani.”] Kunze kwaizvozvo, you are wrong before God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] No child is allowed to rebel against the father, who has nourished him muZita raJeso. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen handisi kumunzwa iyeye hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa ngaapfuure ipapa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka isu takatoro—ropafadzwa kuuya panapa, vana vedu ndozvatinovabata nazvo izvi. Imimi manje mune duty ma brothers, ma duty ma brother; haikonai kumbofa makaregera, kuti mugare pasi nevana venyu muchivaraira. Vanenge vapunyukawo, vapunyuka vanga vazvikurirawo. But pane vanenge munavo vachiri vadiki vaya, ita tsika yekugara pasi nevana vako uchavaratidza maGwaro. Ngavazive kukosha kwe Messa…? [Congregation says, “Message.”] Ngavazive simba rako kwarinodii…? Kwarinobva.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatitarisei muone, handei pa verse 2 iyoyo. Hativerengei tese verse 2 iyoyo. Tese hativerengei tese. Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me. Handei verse 3 tese. The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider. Handei mberi. Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muri kupaona? Kana ari Mwari akuriritira, haa kuchiti uchinonamata Bhaari kana kunoisa mupunzo, it’s unheard of. Saka ini ndichiti vanhu vaMwari mukaona tiri kuuya tichitsanya chu-chu-ehh Chishanu chega chega kudai. Mwari ngaakupe imba. Ngaakupe mari. Ngaakuitire zvinhu zvakanaka che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Woenda kuvana vako wovapa. Ipa vana vako, vakure vachiwana zvavanoda zve…? [Congregation says, “zvese.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Wovaudza kuti, “Makadya Mweya waJeso. Makararama neMweya waJeso. Mota yamaienda nayo kuchikoro, ndeya Jeso. Imba yamaigara ndeya Jeso. Hupfu wamaidya ndehwa Jeso. Hembe dzamaipfeka ndedzaJeso. Hupenzi, kuti ukande pasi chokuna…?!” [Congregation says, “chokunamata.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapa hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatisvetukei tione. Handei kuna Isaiah 63, type yevana vatinoda. Isaiah 63 iyoyo muone. Type yevana vatinoda iyoyo. Tasvika pana Isaiah 63? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Verse 7 muone. Vari kuzvitora sevana vanhu ava. Hativerengei muone. Hativerengei muone tese. I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses. For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED. Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika Amen hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi tiri kukudza vana vakanaka, vana vasinganyepe. Saka ndichava Muraramisi waani…? [Congregation says, “wavo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ma brothers mu Message tine basa rekukudza vana vedu [0:39:24-inaudible] But was Israel like that? God is looking forward to a child who would not lie. A child who would acknowledge that God was his Saviour. But not these ones, ava vairebella [they rebelled—ED] ava.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Aakuti goodness yandakakuitirai… Ndosaka toda mwana anoti kana achibva kuchikoro apfugame, “Nhai baba, ndiri kuenda kuchikoro neyi?” Wonzi, “Nenyasha dzaMwa…?” [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”] Kana chaakurara manheru, ndopaya pandinoti itai altar call nguva nei…? [Congregation says, “nenguva.”] Pa altar call ndopaunofana kutora ma Messages akadai.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Munoziva kuti vakadzi chaivo, chaivo vanofunga kuti dzimwe dzenguva dzimba dzavagere madziri iraki? Ende they can be so naïve to think that it will be forever, when God is angry with them and they will end up living in a hut. Ah! Saka every now and again, you need to sit down with them as a family.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Kunemi ma brother anenge akaita barika aya, “Gara navo kuti garai apa vakadzi vangu, garai apa, garai apa. Ndoda kumbokuratidzai kuti handi’mugere pasofa iri. Wakaritenga ndiwe?” Wonzi, “Handina.” “Ndakaritenga ndinika? Chimira ndikuudze kuti ndakaritenga sei sofa iro. Chiuya tipinde mumota tiende ku grocery. Handi’iri kunakidzaka mota iyi, ndakaitenga nenyasha dza…?” [Congregation says, “dzaMwari.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ehe, waakurara mumachira, wafuga kudai woti, “Chando chinochi vamwe vari muma bridge, vamwe vari muma refugee camp. Isu hona matiri nha…?” [Congregation says, “nhasi.”] Munhu ngaadzidze kutura mafemo achingoti, “Thank you Jesus.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Paunorara manheru kudai, uchingodai, ngaive tsika uchipinda mumachira paunofuga musoro kudai, woti, “Thank you Lord.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukaenda ukanogara pasofa rakanaka woti, “Thank you Lord.” Ukamuka kuseni woti, “Tha…?” [Congregation says, “Thank you Lord. Amen”] NdiMwari nenyasha Dzavo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vana vakakura vachiziva izvozvo mukati meupenyu hwavo brother, haakuvonge muma mako kukutaurira kuti ndachinja Mwari. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles—ED] Unosekaka. Unoti, “Are you normal? Imbanje? What is it?” Now if you look at the brothers, vangani ma brother akauya panapa, vachigara muma boy sky? Vakatenga dzimba vari pano? Rebellious chil…? Vaane dzimba dzamira kudai, neshumiro ino iyi, vana vaanavo vafuta vakufitwa nehembe, zvonzi, “Ta’akubva. Takuenda” Muri kuona zvinoita vanhu? Hee?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Noone will behave like that will ever be innocent before…? [Congregation says, “God.”] Mwari anovatevera vanhu ivavo. Ndosaka muchizoona manje vanozoita minyama, muupenyu hwavo. Ende vagara-gara vanenge vauda kudzoka kuya kuya uko nekuti kuye kwavanga vari kuya kuya vanhu vanenge vasara ikoko vanenge vari nani kuvadarika. Vachingonzwa ma-basa makuru minana.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vakuda kudzokera ikoko kuti vanopuhwa zvinhu nevanhu va…? But vambova ivo vabva vachiganza, kuti, “Taakunoita zvinhu zviri kwazvo.” Ngatinyengeterei gore rino hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngarive gore resa…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation says, “resanduko.”] “Mwari ndoda kukwanisa kuriritira mukadzi wangu, ndoda kukwanisa kuriritira mhuri yangu. Ndoda kuti vana vangu vakure vachitya Mwari wangu.” Hallelujah! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: VaKorinde vekutanga. Handei kuVaKorinde vekutanga. Ini ndonakidzwa hangu nemaGwaro, hameno vamwe. MaGwaro aunofanira kugara unawo ugodzidzisawo mhuri yako. Handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Very nice teaching. VaKorinde vekutanga chapter 12. Hatinzwei kuti Bhaibheri rinoti kudii…? Tasvika?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Very nice teaching. VaKorinde vekutanga, chapter 12. Hatinzweyi kuti Bhaibhiri rinoti kudii. Tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda verse ya… VaKorinde vechipiri, hatisaenda …?... VaKorinde vechipiri, chapter 12. Ndopandinoda kuti munhu wese atsanye apa, achinamata kana uri kuda kuita baba kana kuti amai. You must fast with that Scripture, in mind all the …? [Congregation says, “all the time.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tione pa verse ya 14 tose. Verse 14 tese, VaKorinde vechipiri chapter 12, verse 14, nhaika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tose tione: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba ngavaunganidzire mhuri yavo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiiti Ameni ipapo varanda vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handeyi pa verse ya 15 tese. Hativerengeyi verse 15, tione tese. I will…

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tese, ngatiti Ameni tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndichaparara, ndichipararira imimi. Vana baba ngavaunganidzire va…? [Congregation says, “vana,”] vana. Kwete kuti vana vaunganidzire vana baba. Ha’moona zviri kutaura murume uyu. Vana baba unganidzirai vana. Ndosaka isu tiri kunyengetera kuti, “Baba, vana vedu tingazovachengete sei mu Message? Ivo vachiti vakaenda kuzvikoro kuma colleges, vanonosangana nana Mupfumi, kwaMutare, anenge ane mabhazi. Achiuya nema Benz.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vana vake havadzingwe kuchikoro, vako vadzingwa. Vanouya nehembe dzavanoda. Winter vanenge vane majuzi. Saka iwe uchazotaura sei kuti, “Ndina Mwari?” Unotaura wakamira papi? God Has never wanted it to be tha…? [Congregation says, “that way.”] Mwari ari kuti, “Gugudza!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Gugudza unoita sei…? [Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,’] tsvaka unoita sei…? [Congregation says, ‘unowana,’] kumbira unodii…?” [Congregation says, “unopiwa.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ephesians chapter 6. Provide for your children. …?... Efeso chapter 6 tione. Ephesians chapter 6. Tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tose, verse yaaam 4. Handeyi pa verse ya 4. Verse 4 tese: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dzidzisayi vana venyu nenzira yaMwa…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Tarirai Shoko raMwari zvariri kutaura? Ndosaka ma brothers edu, vana vedu manje vano tanga kutinetsa pa Message, havachada kuitambira. Ende ma sister edu mazhinji akuraka, vana vedu vana Shiphra, vakura. Ha’moona? Vana Sister Chigova ava. Ivo Brother Chigova ava. Vana vemu Message ka ava? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: But mwana akafamba ari munzira yaakagara adzidza yeShoko raMwari akadzikama mairi, even baba vake vabva, Chigova. Iye ari kusara achiropafadzwa vasi…? [Congregation says, “vasipo.”] Ha’moona nyasha dzaMwari zvadzinoita hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Akuitawo vana vake. Akuitawo imba yake. Ndozvazvinofanira kuva. Kwete kuti mwana anozoti kana baba vasisipo, iye akutanga kuita chitsotsi. Akutanga kuita… Haiwazve.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Isu tiri kutarisira kuti tichibva pano, vana vedu vanosara vachingotenda Shoko raMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Esther anofa achinamata muna Mwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, Tito ofa achinamata munani…? [Congregation says, “muna Mwari.”] Munesu chofa chichinamata muna Mwari. Gari chofa chichinamata! Zoe ofa achinamata! Vachingorarama netsika yavakadzidziswa yababa vavo iyoyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Havabve pa teaching ye Message iyoyo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Now, ndopatakanga takasiyana nemaJutah mazhinji manje. MaJutah mazhinji aiziva kuti you have to teach your children. Ha’moona? They knew that. Hatitariseyi kuna Deuteronomy. Deuteronomy unongoona kuti Bhaibhiri rinoti kudii. Hatiapedze maGwaro iwaya. But point yangu yabatika. Handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Deuteronomy. Haah! Muri kuona kuti kutanga kwe chapter uku? Kutanga kwe chapter ka uku? Vari kutanga Deuteronomy. Chapter iri kutanga. Toda kuona kuti Mwari akatanga kuvadzidzisa kuti itai sei? Chapter ichitanga ya Deuteronomy, wakatanga naizvozvo. Deuteronomy chapter 4. Tiripo tose? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right. Deuteronomy chapter 4. Hativerengeyi muone pana verse ya 9. Toda verse 9 chete. Hativerengeyi verse 9 tione tese: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kunzwa Amenika varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiidzokorore verse 9 iyo muone. Iri kutauraka iyi. I Message ka ya Moses iyi. Ndo first Exodus iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo.”] Makaitwa munana pa first Exodus ipapo. Mwari vakaziva kuti vanhu vakasadzidzisa vana vavo, vanhu vacharamba Message iyo…? [Congregation says, “iyoyo,”] iyoyo. Ndobva atanga kutaura nemuporofita Moses. Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tione verse… Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatidzikeyi nayo pa verse 10 tose. Handeyi pa verse 10 tose: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb,

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muri kuona zuva racho rakunotaurwaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zuva iroro rambayi muchiriudza vana vaani…? [Congregation says, “venyu.”] Ha’moona, ehe. Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy …?... in Horeb,

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ini ndoda kuti at—at—at every now and again, zuva rinokosha kuti ugare wakadzidzisa mwana wako, i October 2…? [Congregation says, “2000.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then, wapedza kutaurira vana vako October 2000, gara wakavataurira mhindu pindu dzohupenyu dzevanhu vanoropafadzwa, vagokura vari mu Message. Vagoroora. Vagoita vana. Vagoropafadzwa. Vagotenga dzimba. Voshora mavakanga va…? [Congregation says, “vari.”] Ndinganzwa Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa, ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni iyeye! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Kuti, paive nevanhu vaiita tsika idzodzo dzokuti vakapinda mu Message, anouya asina chinhu, oropafadzwa. Asi anozofurira vana vake, oona vakubva, vakuenda kune imwe chechi. Mweya yetsvina iyi! Dzidzisayi vana venyu pamusoro pe Horeb. Vadzidziseyi. Vazive! Kuti zvinhu zvakadai hazvifaniri kuti zvidii…? [Congregation says, “zviitwe,”] zviitwe, ehe. Zvinhu zvakadai hazvifaniri kuti zviitwe. But, zuva rakati, rirangarireyi; pakauya ten commandments. Zuva rakati rirangarireyi. Zuva rakati rirangarireyi. “Brother, pane vanhu vanotokura paChechi, kutoroora. Kuuya a—ari jaya. Mumwe ouya ori mhandara. Vana vopedza Form 6. Vamwe vototanga first year University, vozoti, ‘PaChechi hapana Mwari.’”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Wonzi, “Ho-o?” “Ehe! Zvinoitika. Kana inini muzoona ndochinja ndodaio. Heh? Ndofunga, ndosaka Paul akati, ‘Ini mukazondiona ndouya ndoparidza imwe Vhangeri, kana ngirozi, ngandive ndakadii….?’” [Congregation says, “ndakatukwa; Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndozvaunofanira kunge uchitaurira vana vako izvozvo uchikura. Kuti, “Shiphra. Ukanzwa mwana wangu ndozosimuka ini baba vako ndakukutaurira kuti, Message kurasika. Ndapindwa nedhimoni rechiKenzamba chai…? [Congregation says, “chairo.”] Mweya yechikore kore yapinda. Yaita kuda kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwayo.”] Nokuti Message iyi, iShoko raMwari!”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi ndozvaunofanira kugara wakadzidzisa vana vako izvo…? [Congregation says, “izvozvo.”] Ha’moona? Handeyi muone pa verse 10. Hativerengeyi. Hativerengeyi verse 10 tese tiipedze. Tese: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they might teach their children.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “… They might teach their…?” [Congregation says, “children; Amen.”] Muri kuona kuti Mwari Chaiye Chaiye akaudza Moses, pa Horeb kuti, “Vaunganidze vanhu ava. Kuti vagare vakandiziva nokukosha Kwangu. Vadzidzise vana vavo kuti varegere kugara vachibuda buda mumakereke saizvo…? [Congregation says, “saizvozvo.”] Varegere vachirega kutsvaga vana mwari vanyowani vavanoona. Vana mwari vana Tamuzi.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Heh? Musikana wese ari pano kana akaroorwa, dzidzisa mwari—si—mwana wako kuti wakaroorwa sei? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende zvakafamba sei kuti uve nemurume waui…?[Congregation says, “wauinaye; Amen.”] “Masangananiro atakaita mwanangu Shiphrah nababa vako ava, vakatanga vandipupurira Message. Ini ndaka’a ndiri mu SU. Takauya, inini vakanga vasina tariro yekuti vandiroore. Vaida mumwe muru—musikana ainzi, Maria Dzenga.” [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Kana history yangu ikasakosha kumwana kwangu—wangu, inokosha ndeya…? [Congregation says, “ndeyani?”] Unovaudzeyi kana ukasavaudza pamusoro pezvababa vavo? Nemawananiro amakadii…? [Congregation says, “amakaita.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mai Zane vouya voti, “Mwanangu, ndini wokutanga kupinda pabarika. Ndakaona chitsvuku. Hamuna kuuya zviri nyore imi. Mamai ese akanga aripo panguva iyoyo vachinzwa muApostora achiparidza kekutanga kuti barika, ini ndichibvuma. Ndakapuhwa mazita ose anopuhwa vanhu pasi pano. Hure, chii…? Vana mai vavo ivo pa—Apostora, vana mainini vavo vese vachindishaudha kuti ndi—usavapo. Makava pano just because God wanted you to be here! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chirega kuzoita hupenzi hwekuti kana wakura unoshora Shoko iro…? [Congregation says, “iroro.”] Dai Shoko iri risina kumbobvira rakauya panyika pano, ungadei usi…?” [Congregation says, “usipo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwana iyeye anotozviziva kuti kuvapo kwangu, i Message. But do you know kuti we take for granted these things? Handizivi kuti tinofunga kuti vachazviziva… [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation says, “sei?”] And I don’t know, how you you will ever make your child appreciate being in the Message? Without sitting time—down with them, uchivaudza ma facts ehupe…? [Congregation says, “ehupenyu?”] Ngavazive vana ava! “Mwanangu, ini ndaive rombe ini.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ini ndogara ndichitaura kuti, “Aah!” Pa—papurupiti ndonyasha dzandiinadzo. Vamwe ha—hamuna nyasha dzepurupiti. But gara pasi nevana vako. “Kuti isu tanga tiri mhuka! Taidya mbeva, mharapara, madora, madhumbudya, hwiza. Tairara nenyoka mumba. Tomuka todziona dzavapo kuseni. Katsi. Tichiwumburuka, makanga muchidziiwa nendove.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: “Then God rich in…?” [Congregation says, “mercy; Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiye akazotiita zvatiri nha…? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “nhasi.”] Nhasi ta’akubuda mumotokari? Heh? Taienda kuchigayo nebhagidhi riri apa. [Apostle Gumbura points at his head—ED] Tigoenda kunochera mvura murukova, tichiisa apa. [Apostle Gumbura demonstrates by pointing at his head—ED] Inini. Kana taita raki, [lucky—ED] tinenge tawana ane chikochikari chisina kuzara chiri kuenda nai…? [Congregation says, “naikoko.”; Congregation laughs—ED] Asi Mwari nenyasha!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Dzidzisa vana venyu kuti vakoshese Me…? [Congregation says, “Message.”] You are what you are… You are you. You are healthy. You are rich. You—you are confident. You are looking forward to tomorrow. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuda kweShoko iro…?[Congregation says, “irori.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzokunzwa ngavadii..? [Congregation says, ‘ngavanzwe,’] zvinotaura chiyi…? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya,’] Mweya kupiko…?” [Congregation says, “kuKereke; Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Unofanira kuti, “Vanangu kana ma’a muchinakidza kuchikoro, muchingonzi, ‘Vana VaGumbura, vana VaGumbura, the Gumburas, Gumburas; iShoko rakatenda baba venyu iri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mungade muri pabarika ren’anga rinonzwisa tsitsi zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”] Muchisekwa kuchikoro mune complex asingadii…? [Congregation says, “isingaite.”] Iye zvino you are shining stars pachikoro ipapo, nekuda kwenyasha dzaMwari!’” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “You are loveable kids. Liked by everybody, to provoke jealousy in a witch. But the same God who made you that way, is capable of protecting you!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tione. Handeyi muone pamberi pacho pana, Deuteronomy chapter 6. Nyaya yanga yakakosha iyi. Haina kumbotambwa nayo zvacho…?
