[Congregation says, “zvachose.”] Deuteronomy chapter 6. Tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda verse 4. Tasvika tese ipapo? Hatiiteyi Ameni kana tasvika tese ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aiwa Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengeyi tose. Verse 4 tese. Tese: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: Handeyi mberi. And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might. Verse 6: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hah? Handeyi mberi muone. Handeyi mberi, verse 7 tese. And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura laughs—ED] Ameni handisi kumunzwa iyeye hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Munotaura makagara mumba senyaya. Muchifamba, taurai. Mava kuvata, taurayi nenyaya iyi, handiti?” Hanzi taurayi pamusoro pazvo nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndosaka manje tiri kuita problem mu Message, yekuti vana vedu vari kuti vakangokura, voshora Message. Nokuti nguva yakafanana neyakadai, hatina kumboziva kukosha kokudzidzisa mwana wako kukosha kwayo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Blessing anofanira kuenda pa Tynwald achiziva kuti, she wouldn’t be there, if it wasn’t the—for the God, of the Message of the Hour. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Akanyengwa nemukomana asinganamate anoramba oga kuti, “Hah, kwatinobva isu matendero edu, hazviiti. Iwe wabva wadya mushonga. Wabva wadya porridge remushonga. Wabva watemwa nyora. Wodanana neni inini? Inini kubva ndiri mudiki, handizivi chinonzi kana kurapira nhova. Takasiyana zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaite.”] Kwatinobva kwakasiyana.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: “Shamwari, ini handiroorwe pachechi—pachikoro panapa, na any one of you. Kunze kwekunge makatemerwa kuti munamate Mwari watinonama…?” [Congregation says, “watinonamata.”] “Anombori Mwari akaita sei? Ini ndinoenda ku Methodist.” Woti, “Aah, iyeye hatimunamate iyeye.” “Ko, munonamata akaita sei?” “Tinoti watinonamata anowanikwa paNzvimbo Tsve…?” [Congregation says, “Tsvene.”] Tingaita Ameni here ipapapa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aaamen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Mwari watinonamata anowanikwa paNzvimbo Tsve…?” [Congregation says, “Tsvene.”] “Chii chinonzi Nzvimbo Tsvene?” “Nzvimbo, iyo Mwari vakaisa Zita Ravo pairi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Aah! Pane nzvimbo yakaiswa Zita naMwari?” Woti, “Ehe! It’s a Body Word.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] It’s a Body...? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “Word!”: Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Iroro Shoko iroro rine power. Rokuti baba vangu inini shamwari…” Anenge akutotanga kupupura ipapo.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: “Baba vangu vakache—vakararama kusvika fifty four years. Hapana airapirwa nhova. Takazvarwa kusvika kuma thirty. Hapana aienda kun’anga. Pamba pedu hatizvizive zvokumhanya ku hospital kana kudaidza amburance. Pamba pedu taingoona Mwari achi provider siku nei…? [Congregation says, “nesikati.”] Hatina kumboshaya kuchikoro kwataidii…? kwataienda. Taive nehutano hwedu, takanga tisingarware. Apisa muviri, mawoko pamusoro nekuzodzwa namafuta. Apisa muviri, mawoko pamusoro. Vana mai vedu vaienda ku hospital kuno deliver che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Shamwarika, ukanzwa zvichinzi Mwari ndewe munana, ini ndakaiona!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tingaita Ameni here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Taurai pamusoro paMwari uyu nguva dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”] Ha’moona? Zvino vazhinji vedu manje, we let our children grow. And they take the blessings that they are enjoying every day for gra…? [Congregation says, “for granted.”] Vanofunga kuti kugona kwavo. How can you blame children, when wives are not even appreciative of what is being done by God to their hu…? [Congregation says, “husbands,”] husbands. Vana vadii…? Heh?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vana mai vanogona kutadza kuona chiri kuitwa naMwari, kuna baba. Kuti iye ari kufamba nemota. Akachena. Ane hembe dzaanoda. Anorara pakanaka. Adya zvakanaka. Ane’mba. Akasamboona Message yacho. Kutoiti, “Ini handizivi chandakarasikira mu Message ini? Iyo nyaya yavo yokuparidza barika iyoyo inondibhowa stereki.”

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Kutobatana nehama dzake dzepanyama. Vachibatsira kutuka Message iyoyo. Mwana wake musikana mukuru aripo. Then you slow progress. Here brother, development should be galloping. [Congregation says, “hamuchaigari.”] Nekuda kwemabatiro enyu eShoko asi vana venyu, vachagara nhaka yanga yakafanira kuita ya…?” [Congregation says, “yenyu.”] Kuti vana vaya vaya vakupe mhosva iwe…? [Congregation says, “iwewe.”] Ndiwe ungade wakaticha. Ukaramba Message iyi hazvirevi kuti waitiza forever. Vanhu vari kutiza Message ava, vana vavo ndovachavapa correction. Vana vaya vachapinda mu Message iya nemwoyo yavo yo…? [Congregation says, “yose.”] Vorarama chaizvo zvinotaura Spoken Word chai…? [Congregation says, “chairo.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Voti, “Baba handidi Shoko rokuudzwa nevanhu vanotuka vanhu, ndoda nda-zvandinokuratidzai panyama baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mirai ndikuratidzei Mwari wandinonamata zvaandiitira kwete wenyu uyu. Asingakuitei kuti muriritire vana, anokuitirai kuti muti uraye nenzara. Mutadze kutiendesa kuchikoro. Haandi Mwari iyeye, wangu Inini Mwari, anondidzidzisa kuchengeta vana vangu nemazvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba kunyangwe mukaita argument yei, makanga musinganamate nemai…? [Congregation says, “nemazvo.”] Mwari vakati, “Ndinozarura window rei…?’’ [Congregation says, “redenga.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngaapfuure ipapo Ameni iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ma brother ese akabva panapa ari something. I challenge them, I gave them those things. Vakazviwana vachinamata pa…? [Congregation says, “pano.”] Munhu wese akatenga sabhabhu pano naMwari wandinonama… wandinonamata. Ukatenga mota hupenyu hwako hukanaka, I challenge those guys kuti life ngairambe iri zvayanga yakadii…? [Congregation says, “yakaita.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Muchaona kuti Mwari vachivhara denga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika Ameni ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ko hama dzedu dzemuna October 2000, Mwari akavhara denga here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aah, ah, gwiba zvakanaka-naka, nekuti pane nzvimbo Mwari yavanosangana newe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pane nzvimbo Mwari yavakudaira [Congregation says, “Amen,”] pane burden of being called. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatirairei vana vedu vasakanganwe! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatisimukei hedu tese. Vakauya (Baba) vamwe vachibvunza, (Isu) Tingapone here, Hongu tinoda muponisiwe, (Baba) Nesu tinodaro. KORASI (Ini ndoda) Ndoda, (ndoda) ndoda, Ndoda Mwari muyamuri, Muri wangu, Ndakatengwa (Ishe) neRopa raIshe, (Zvino) Ndava Wenyu chose.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Wava here wavo chose? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iti Mwari ndoda kukugamuchirai manheru anhasi. Ndoda kuti muve vangu chose. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndakugamuchirai Jehovah, mhuri yamunondipa ndichainongedzera kuna Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tora pride mukudzidzisa vana vako Jesu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Honai mai va Charles na John Wesley, nanhasi tiri kuvataura. Vakadzidzisa vana vavo kuda Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzvadzi yangu, hama yangu, unoudza mwana wako chii zuva rese raunoswera naye?

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hezvo unoti hatina nyaya dzekutaura tose. Ko idzodzo dzemanana aJehovah wakapedza here? Iti nhasi ndichaita Baba, kubva nhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndichaudza vana vangu pamusoro pehukuru hwaMwari... [Inaudible 1:37:19] Satani tama muhupenyu hwangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Come out of me, Satan! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda victory yaMwari chaiyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba, kuti vana vateerere, ndokunge vaona imimi mandiitira chimwe chinhu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imi ma manifester simba Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imi maratidza hukuru hwenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndoda change of status! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zarurai hwindo redenga, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] zadzai noMweya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nhasi izuva redu rokutsanya. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndinotsuura mweya yemadzinza, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndinotsuura unemployment, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndinotsuura barreness, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndinotsuura hurwere, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ndinotsuura division, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] in the Name of Jesus! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Manheru ano Baba ndoda kunyatsobuda muno ndasunungurwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Gugudza unozarurirwa, tsvaka unowana, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] kumbira unopihwa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndiitirei nyasha manheru ano. (Ini ndoda) Ndoda, (ndoda) ndoda, Ndoda Mwari muyamuri, Muri wangu, (Ishe) Ndakatengwa (Ishe wangu) neRopa raIshe, (Zvino) Ndava Wenyu chose.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatinyengeterei tose manheru ano. ... (My Lord) I was sick and dying, On the Jericho road, When He poured in the oil and the wine. (Apostle says, “One more time, all of us. Let’s raise our hands to Him now.”) (Hallelujah) He poured in the oil and the wine (Hallelujah) The time He restoreth my soul (My Lord) I was sick and dying On the Jericho road, When He poured in the oil and the wine.

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwari vaAbrahama, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Mwari vebarika, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] God of polygamy, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] mufaro wedu kuva mukati memba ino manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari ndinokutendai ini, nekuda kwenyasha dzenyu muhupenyu hwangu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba, zvakawanda zvatakasangana nazvo, asi sezvinotaura Shoko renyu, “Many are the afflictions of the righteous, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] but the Lord delivereth him from all of them.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Ishe Jeso Kristu vakativimbisa kuti tichawana dzimba, hanzvadzi, madzimai, vana, with persecutions. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tinotenda sei nekuti takazviona zvichiita nyama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari zodzai Vhangeri yataparidzirana nhasi, pa message, iyi Nzvimbo tsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hakuna mushonga uno survivor mu Message, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] hakuna dhimoni rinopinda mu Message. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Baba, “To them that believe, all things are possible.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satan, come out right away! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Batsirai mumwe nemumwe ari mukati memba ino Jehovah ayende ku destiny yake, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] adopted son and daughter of God. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudzimba tinokutendai, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vana tinokutendai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari chitipai kuti tidzidzise vana ava, mudzimba idzi, hukuru hwenyu Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pashaikwe anodzokera kumasure Tenzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Mwari makanaka vakure vachiziva Mwari uyu. Ndosaka nanhasi Baba maJuta rudzi runoramba rwakabatana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vairamba vakanongedzera kuvana, zvakaitwa naMwari wavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nanhasi tinoverenga pamusoro penyaya idzi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Isu, mouyawo pakati pevahedheni Baba, makatiitira minana yakawanda Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Vakawanda vakabatsirwa vakanga vasina vana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vamwe vakanga vaine ma difficulties e breach, Baba kuitirwa tsvina mudumbu, Baba kunzi hauna power yeku deliver, kupererwa nemweya, we give You the glory. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakauya vari marombe vazhinji pano Baba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vari mhuka dzesango, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] I am one of them, Lord, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] the Message delivered. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka Ishe, ngatiregerei kukanganwa kwatakawana dzimba, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti takanga tiri muma boy sky. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Hatiregerei kukanganwa kwatakakudzira vana, kuti vakakudzwa pasina n’anga, pasina mushonga, pasina mudzimu waipinda mumhuri iyoyo nekuda kwe Message iyoyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari Message ngaitiitire nyasha, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari, kune vanenge vakabva pariri, varikufurira Baba wakanaka kuti vamwe vabvewo, Imi makadzidzisa Mozisi kuti tanga kutora dombo rokutanga umukache. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari tinotsuura vanhu ivavo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Nekuda kwesimba ravanenge vainaro pane vanhu vakasara pano, Mwari vanounza influence yekutadza kunamata kwakanaka pane vasara. Nekudaro chivaburitsai pachena. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chivafumurai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiyo nzira yamungatirwire nayo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nekuti hakuchatemwa vanhu nematombo makore ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Varatidzirirei pachena chena nekushaikwa kwehupenyu hwakanaka, hunokundwa nevakasara. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Chinjai status... [Inaudible 1:43:03] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiitei zvimiro zvinoenderana nezvatino claimer. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ratidzai kuti muri pano, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] nemararamiro edu, Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satan, come out right now! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiuyai muite nyasha Baba, Tenzi makanaka tive tinobatanidza Mwenga, kubudikidza nekuverengwa as written epistles. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.text: Ngativei tinouya kwamuri Baba, tozvipira sezvibairo zvipenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tipei nyasha pakufamba kwatinoita mangwana tichienda Gweru. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda negohwo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotenda nehutano, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tinotenda Baba wakanaka netarisiro ye message mangwana, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tipei zvakatiringana. entries.title: Nzvimbo Tsvene (Part 3)- (Believers & Their Children)
entries.text: Tinotenda kunaka kwenyu nemufaro watinawo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kurwirwa munharaunda ino Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kudzwai namatwai nekusingaperi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiitai kuti ma hearts desires edu ese akachena, azadzikiswe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. entries.text: Baba tinotenda nezvipo. Zvabuda muhomwe dzevana venyu, ropafadzai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Good measure, pressed down, shaken over,” tozvisevenzesa kubasa renyu.
